normalization: Existing UTF-8 LF text: strip only ASCII SP and TAB at the end of each original line; remove empty EOF lines after stripping; retain one final LF. Internal whitespace, diagnostics and all other bytes are unchanged.
purpose: These 55 paths are commit text views, NOT the original raw bytes. All historical log hashes, publication indices, freezes and receipts continue to bind the original raw evidence, reconstructed and verified using raw_sha256. No historical report or receipt has been rewritten.
reconstruction: Validate view bytes and SHA256 first. Split view without final LF into LF-delimited lines.
Append one empty line for each removed_eof_blank_lines record in original line order.
Append each trailing_sp_tab suffix to its 1-based original_line. Suffix and EOF text strings contain only JSON-escaped SP or TAB.
Check each restored EOF line equals its recorded text; join every original line with LF and add final LF. Validate raw_bytes/raw_sha256.
